CustomField.description: TRUE when this term is Active and today falls within its start/end window. The current board = Board Terms where Is Current = true. JSI-123 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.formula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), Start_Date__c <= TODAY(), OR(ISBLANK(End_Date__c), End_Date__c >= TODAY()) )
CustomField.label: Is Current
